name: hangman
description: Hangman game service. Every interaction — starting a round, asking for a hint, quitting, and EVERY letter / word guess — comes in on `game.hangman.command` with content either a JSON `{action, theme?, value?}` (preferred) or a loose string. Recognised actions: `start` (optional theme = anything, e.g. 'cuisine', 'animals', 'star wars'), `hint`, `quit`, `status`, and `guess` (the letter / full word to play in `value`). Examples — content=`{"action":"start","theme":"cuisine"}`, `{"action":"guess","value":"a"}`, or loose strings like `start cuisine` / `guess a`. The game narrates every event on `chat.response` so every connected chat surface stays in sync.

default_subscriptions.description: Sole entry point for the game. Publish `{"action":"start"}` (optionally with `theme`) to start a round, `{"action":"hint"}` for a clue, `{"action":"quit"}` to abandon, `{"action":"status"}` to publish the current state. To play a letter / full-word guess: `{"action":"guess","value":"a"}` or `{"action":"guess","value":"banana"}` — classifier rejects anything that isn't a single letter or a word of the answer's length. The brain node should forward EVERY letter the player types here while a game is active; classification + game logic happen inside the handler.
